rules.name: Password spray against many accounts
rules.query:
// Password spray: one source address fails sign-in for many distinct accounts within an hour.
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize FailedAccounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName), Attempts = count(), EventIds = make_set(EventId) by IPAddress, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailedAccounts >= 5

rules.name: Successful sign-in from a spraying address
rules.query:
// A successful sign-in from an address that failed for five or more accounts in the same hour.
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where ResultType != "0"
    | summarize FailedAccounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where FailedAccounts >= 5
  ) on IPAddress, Window
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location, FailedAccounts, EventId

rules.name: PowerShell with an encoded command
rules.query:
// PowerShell started with an encoded command line.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "powershell.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine contains "-enc"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountUpn, InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, EventId

rules.name: Office application starts a script interpreter
rules.query:
// An Office application starts a script interpreter (macro or malicious document).
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "mshta.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountUpn, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, EventId

rules.name: LSASS memory dump
rules.query:
// Credential dumping through the comsvcs.dll MiniDump export or procdump against LSASS.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump" or (ProcessCommandLine has "procdump" and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountUpn, InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessCommandLine, EventId

rules.name: Volume shadow copies deleted
rules.query:
// Volume shadow copies deleted (a common step before encryption).
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountUpn, InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessCommandLine, EventId

rules.name: Connection to a threat-intel address
rules.query:
// Outbound connection to an active address on the threat-intelligence feed.
DeviceNetworkEvents
| join kind=inner (
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where Active == true and isnotempty(NetworkIP) and ExpirationDateTime > now()
    | project RemoteIP = NetworkIP, IndicatorId, ConfidenceScore
  ) on RemoteIP
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, InitiatingProcessFileName, IndicatorId, ConfidenceScore, EventId

rules.name: Click on a threat-intel domain
rules.query:
// A user clicked a link whose domain is an active indicator on the threat-intelligence feed.
UrlClickEvents
| where ActionType == "ClickAllowed"
| extend UrlDomain = tostring(parse_url(Url).Host)
| join kind=inner (
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where Active == true and isnotempty(DomainName) and ExpirationDateTime > now()
    | project UrlDomain = DomainName, IndicatorId, ConfidenceScore
  ) on UrlDomain
| project TimeGenerated, AccountUpn, Url, UrlDomain, IndicatorId, ConfidenceScore, EventId

rules.name: Click on a link in a phishing message
rules.query:
// A user clicked a link in a message that Defender for Office 365 classified as phishing.
UrlClickEvents
| where ActionType == "ClickAllowed"
| join kind=inner (
    EmailEvents
    | where ThreatTypes has "Phish"
    | project NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, Subject
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| project TimeGenerated, AccountUpn, Url, SenderFromAddress, Subject, EventId

rules.name: Mailbox rule forwards externally
rules.query:
// A mailbox rule forwards mail to an external address.
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule")
| where IsExternal == true
| project TimeGenerated, AccountUpn, Destination, IPAddress, EventId

rules.name: Mass file download
rules.query:
// Fifty or more files downloaded by one account in a day (a static threshold; UEBA adds per-user baselines).
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "FileDownloaded"
| summarize Files = count(), TotalMB = sum(SizeMB), EventIds = make_set(EventId) by AccountUpn, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where Files >= 50

rules.name: Uploads to an external cloud destination
rules.query:
// Five or more uploads to an external destination by one account within an hour.
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "FileUploaded" and IsExternal == true
| summarize Uploads = count(), TotalMB = sum(SizeMB), Destinations = make_set(Destination), EventIds = make_set(EventId) by AccountUpn, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where Uploads >= 5
